result.reveal: (x,y,w=14,h=12)=>{let s=__mock.state.state,key=s.scene;let f=s.sessionKind==='session1'&&key==='interior'?s.fog:(s.sceneFog[key]||=[]);for(let r=Math.max(0,Math.floor((y-h/2)*20/100));r<=Math.min(19,Math.ceil((y+h/2)*20/100));r++)for(let c=Math.max(0,Math.floor((x-w/2)*32/100));c<=Math.min(31,Math.ceil((x+w/2)*32/100));c++)if(!f.includes(r+','+c))f.push(r+','+c);s.tokens.filter(t=>t.team==='pc'&&t.placed).forEach((t,i)=>{t.x=x-4+i*2;t.y=y+4});__mock.combat.commit('MOCK current room revealed, earlier areas remain recorded');}
